title: Main page service cards with water waves scroll animation and full pricing

requirements.summary: Display all 8 service cards on Home page with vertical stacked layout and water-waves scroll animation that triggers sequentially
acceptanceCriteria: Home page shows exactly 8 service category cards
On scroll, each card animates in one at a time with a water-waves / ripple-pop effect
Cards appear sequentially (staggered), not all at once
Animation triggers via IntersectionObserver (visible only when scrolled into view)

file_operations.description: Replace the existing ServiceCategoryGrid component with a new vertically stacked layout of 8 service cards. Each card must use IntersectionObserver to trigger a water-waves animation effect on scroll with staggered delays. Position this section after the stats section and before the 'Why Choose Us' section. Each card should be clickable and trigger expansion inline.

Create a new component that displays a service category card with an image from frontend/public/assets/generated/ (e.g., generated/pest-control-category.dim_800x500.jpg), title, and brief description. On click, expand inline to show all subcategories and pricing without navigation. Include IntersectionObserver logic for water-waves animation with configurable stagger delay prop. Use transform scale and wave-like cubic-bezier easing for the ripple-pop effect.

Add CSS keyframes and classes for the water-waves / ripple-pop animation effect. Define a @keyframes rule that scales from 0.8 to 1 with a wave-like cubic-bezier easing function (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)). Include opacity transition from 0 to 1. Add utility classes for applying this animation with various stagger delays.

requirements.summary: Clicking any service card on Home page opens full categories and pricing inline or as expanded panel without navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a service card on the Home page directly reveals its categories and pricing without navigating to another page
No intermediate step or extra navigation required
All subcategories and prices for the clicked service are visible

file_operations.description: Implement inline expansion state management within the ServiceCardWithExpansion component. When clicked, toggle an expanded state that reveals a panel below the card showing all subcategories with their pricing. Use smooth height transition animations. Ensure only one card can be expanded at a time by managing expansion state at the parent level in Home.tsx.

Create a component that displays the full expanded view of a service's subcategories and pricing. Accept service data as props and render all categories, subcategories, prices, and action buttons. For services with square footage pricing, integrate the PricingCalculator component. Include WhatsApp and Book Now buttons for each subcategory. Display Add-on Options as selectable checkboxes at the bottom.

requirements.summary: Update services.ts with complete pricing for all 8 services including Pest Control subcategory groups, service visit charges, and add-on options
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 service categories have complete and accurate pricing data in services.ts
Pest Control has three subcategory groups: Residential (flat), Commercial (per sq.ft), Construction (per sq.ft)
Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC Services, Appliances Repair all show ₹499 service visit charge
Add-on options are stored and shown for all services

file_operations.description: Replace existing service data with the complete pricing structure for all 8 services. For Pest Control, create three subcategory groups (residential with flat pricing, commercial per sq.ft, construction per sq.ft). Add serviceVisitCharge field (₹499) to Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC Services, and Appliances Repair categories. Create a new addOnOptions array containing Same Day Emergency (+₹999), Sunday/Holiday (+₹799), and Warranty Certificate (Included). Update the ServiceCategory type definition to support subcategoryGroups, pricingType (flat or perSqFt), serviceVisitCharge, and addOnOptions fields.

requirements.summary: Add inline square footage calculator for Pest Control Commercial and Construction subcategories with real-time total price computation
acceptanceCriteria: Commercial and Construction pest control subcategories show a sq.ft input field
Entering a sq.ft value calculates and displays the total price in real time
Book Now and WhatsApp buttons use the calculated price in the pre-filled message
Residential pest control shows flat pricing without a calculator

file_operations.description: Create a component that accepts per-sq.ft pricing and renders an input field for square footage. Calculate and display the total price in real time as the user types (e.g., 800 sq.ft × ₹6 = ₹4,800). Include validation for numeric input. Pass the calculated total to Book Now and WhatsApp action buttons. Style with clear labels and prominent total display.

Conditionally render the PricingCalculator component for Pest Control Commercial and Construction subcategory groups. For flat pricing subcategories (Residential), display the price directly without a calculator. Pass the calculator's computed total to the WhatsApp link and booking form.

requirements.summary: Display Add-on Options as selectable checkboxes in every expanded service panel with costs reflected in total and WhatsApp messages
acceptanceCriteria: Add-on options appear in every expanded service panel
Selecting Emergency or Holiday toggles adds the cost to the displayed total
Warranty Certificate is always shown as included at no extra charge
Selected add-ons are reflected in WhatsApp pre-filled messages

file_operations.description: Create a component that displays add-on options (Same Day Emergency +₹999, Sunday/Holiday +₹799, Warranty Certificate - Included) as checkboxes or toggle chips. Manage selected state and compute the total add-on cost. Pass selected add-ons and total cost to parent via callback. Style the Warranty Certificate option to indicate it's always included at no extra charge (e.g., with a checkmark icon and disabled state).

Integrate the AddOnOptions component at the bottom of each expanded service panel. Track selected add-ons state and add their costs to the displayed service total. Include selected add-on details in the WhatsApp pre-filled message format (e.g., 'Add-ons: Same Day Emergency +₹999'). Pass the updated total to all Book Now and WhatsApp buttons.

Create a utility function that generates WhatsApp pre-filled messages including service name, subcategory, base price, selected add-ons with costs, and final total. Handle both flat pricing and per-sq.ft calculated pricing. Format the message clearly with line breaks and itemized costs.
